_comment: Template only - never contains real credentials, safe to commit. Copy this file to sage_employee_puller.json next to the script (wherever you deploy it) and fill in real values there. The real one is gitignored (see .gitignore in this folder) so it can never be committed by accident. Full docs in README_CON.md.
_companies_comment: Which Sage Company Numbers this host serves, and the local ODBC DSN for each, are no longer set here - they live on this controller's own Sage Remote Controller record in Frappe (Attendance workspace > Payroll > Sage Remote Controller), matched to whichever User api_key/api_secret above belong to. Create that record (or ask a Payroll Manager to) before running this script - fetched fresh every heartbeat cycle, so a newly-enabled Company/edited DSN needs no redeploy here.
